items.definition:
a race between teams; a device that passes on an electrical signal
The 4x100 meter relay team won the gold medal.

a large structure for drilling for oil or gas; a particular type of equipment
The oil rig was visible from the coastline.

an action displaying spectacular skill; something unusual done to attract attention
The movie featured many dangerous stunts.

synchronization
Make sure your calendar is in sync with your phone.

a person who pays taxes
Taxpayers fund public services.

a series of three related novels, plays, or films
The Lord of the Rings is a famous fantasy trilogy.

a charge or claim that someone has done something illegal or wrong
He denied the accusation of theft.

food used to attract fish or other animals
He put some worms on the hook as bait.

the relationship between brothers; a feeling of friendship and understanding among people
They shared a strong sense of brotherhood.

the suppression or prohibition of any parts of books, films, news, etc. that are considered obscene, politically unacceptable, or a threat to security
The government imposed strict censorship on the media.

a collection of things, especially musical recordings or literary works
She released a compilation of her greatest hits.

communication by exchange of letters or emails
We maintain regular correspondence with our overseas clients.

the advocacy of women's rights on the basis of the equality of the sexes
Feminism advocates for equal rights for all genders.

a fault or weakness in a person's character; a defect in something
The only flaw in the plan was the lack of funding.

a hard, white substance from the tusks of elephants
The piano keys were made of ivory.

a long-playing record
He still collects old LPs.

the act of controlling or influencing someone or something skillfully, often unfairly
The manipulation of data can lead to false conclusions.

a specialized segment of the market for a particular kind of product or service
He found his niche in the tech industry.

a statement or assertion that expresses a judgment or opinion
He made an interesting proposition during the meeting.

a period of temporary economic decline
The country is currently experiencing a recession.

a curve that winds around a central point
The staircase had a beautiful spiral design.

a university student who has not yet received a first degree
She is an undergraduate student studying history.

a feeling of discontented or resentful longing aroused by someone else's possessions, qualities, or luck
He felt a pang of envy when he saw her new car.

the state of being barred from one's native country, typically for political or punitive reasons
The political leader lived in exile for many years.

a person confined to an institution
The inmate was released after serving his sentence.

exclusive control of a commodity or service
The company has a monopoly on the software market.

extreme anger or shock
There was public outrage over the decision.

the act of resuming or extending
The contract is due for renewal next month.

the killing of animals for food; violent killing of people
The slaughter of innocent people was condemned.

the process of making something active or operative
The activation of the alarm system prevented the theft.

a town or district that is an administrative unit
The borough council is responsible for local services.

a sudden, dramatic, and important discovery or development
Scientists announced a major breakthrough in cancer research.

the state or process of rotting or decomposition
The old wooden house showed signs of decay.

power and influence over others
The company achieved market dominance with its new product.

an opening that can be closed by a gate; a means of access or entry
The city is often called the gateway to the West.

mental images, figurative language
The poem used vivid imagery to describe the sunset.

a small island
We visited a beautiful isle in the Caribbean.

a good reason for something
There was no justification for his rude behavior.

an organized crime syndicate
The movie was about the Italian Mafia.

a person sent on a religious mission
The missionary traveled to remote villages to help people.

patriotic feeling, principles, or efforts
The rise of nationalism can lead to conflict.

an unintentional error; supervision
It was an unfortunate oversight on my part.

an original model
They are testing the new prototype of the car.

a device to control a nuclear chain reaction
The nuclear power plant has several reactors.

a solution or cure
There is no easy remedy for this problem.

a newly established business
He works for a tech startup.

a software application that runs automated tasks over the internet
The website uses a bot to answer common questions.

firm conviction that something is true
There is no certainty about the outcome.

a quotation from or reference to a book, paper, or author
Please include a citation for all sources.

a gathering of people, especially for religious worship
The minister addressed the congregation.

the complete loss or absence of hope
She felt a sense of despair after losing her job.

a sum of money paid regularly by a company to its shareholders
The company announced a higher dividend for its investors.

a stable subatomic particle
An electron carries a negative electric charge.

a small part broken or separated off something
We found a fragment of pottery at the archaeological site.

an influential teacher or expert
He is considered a marketing guru in the industry.

a regulatory substance produced in an organism
Hormones play a crucial role in regulating body functions.

a thin, pliable sheet or layer
The cell is surrounded by a protective membrane.

the action of modifying something
They made a slight modification to the original design.

a person who commits murder
The police arrested the murderer.

a fine-grained gray, green, or bluish-purple metamorphic rock
The roof was covered with slate tiles.

a sudden powerful forward or upward movement
There was a sudden surge in power.

a thing serving as a tangible representation of a fact, quality, feeling, etc.
Please accept this small gift as a token of my appreciation.

the soft diffused light from the sky when the sun is below the horizon
We enjoyed a walk in the twilight.

the quality or state of being prepared to do something
Her willingness to help was appreciated.
